about.title: Kirkwood, California
about.extract: Kirkwood is an unincorporated community in Alpine and Amador counties, California, United States. Kirkwood's main attraction is the Kirkwood Mountain Resort. The town is accessible by State Route 88. Kirkwood is within the Eldorado National Forest. The population was 190 at the 2020 census. For statistical purposes, the United States Census Bureau has defined Kirkwood as a census-designated place (CDP).

sites.about: Campground is located next to beautiful Lake Kirkwood. Lake Kirkwood offers opportunities for fishing, swimming, paddleboarding, and non-motorized boating such as kayaking. All sites are first come first serve.

sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: Lovers Leap Campground has 21 single-family walk-in (tent only) campsites near the South Fork of the American River. Lovers Leap is a large granitic cliff that is nearly 600 feet tall at its apex and is visible from the campground. It is a renowned rock climbing area.
sites.directions: 43 miles east of Placerville on Highway 50, 0.5 miles east of Strawberry Lodge on Strawberry Lodge Road.
